extension.description: Install, switch and remove Node versions from the VS Code status bar (nvm, nvm-windows, fnm, Volta, asdf)
cmd.useRequired: PickVerNode: Use the version the project requires
cmd.writeNvmrc: PickVerNode: Write .nvmrc with the current version
cmd.openWalkthrough: PickVerNode: Open the getting started guide
cmd.revealBinFolder: PickVerNode: Reveal the active version folder
cmd.enableCorepack: PickVerNode: Activate the project package manager (corepack)
cmd.checkFolders: PickVerNode: Show the Node version per folder
cmd.copyBinPath: PickVerNode: Copy the active version bin path
cfg.updateTerminalEnv: Prefix the chosen version bin in terminal.integrated.env (shell-scoped managers only: nvm POSIX, fnm)
cfg.elevate: Windows: run 'nvm use' elevated (nvm-windows needs admin for the symlink)
cfg.autoWriteNvmrc: Update the project .nvmrc every time the version is switched
cfg.nvmrcPrefixV: Write .nvmrc with a v prefix (v20.18.0) instead of 20.18.0
cfg.pollSeconds: How often, in seconds, to check whether the version changed outside this window (only while the window has focus). 0 = only when focus returns
cfg.checkRequiredVersion: Compare the active version with the one the project pins (`.nvmrc`, `.node-version`, `.tool-versions`, `package.json#volta.node` or `package.json#engines.node`) and turn the status bar orange when they do not match. It never switches the version on its own.
cfg.notifyRequiredVersion: Also show a notification the first time the active version is found not to satisfy what the project requires
cfg.warnEndOfLife: Show the support status of Node versions: the end-of-life date in the version list and the tooltip, and an orange status bar when the active version no longer gets support. Turn it off to remove every end-of-life hint (it also stops the notification and the nodejs/Release schedule lookup).
cfg.notifyEndOfLife: Also show a notification the first time an unsupported version is used. It can be muted per version from the notification itself. Requires pickvernode.warnEndOfLife.
cfg.showAvailableVersions: List, besides the installed ones, the still-supported versions that can be installed, with their support status. Reads `nodejs.org/dist/index.json` and the `nodejs/Release` schedule; with no network the list shows only the installed versions.
cfg.telemetry: Send anonymous usage telemetry (which manager is used, which commands are run). Paths, project names and file contents are never sent. It is also disabled by the global `#telemetry.telemetryLevel#` setting.
terminalProfile.title: Node (PickVerNode)
walkthrough.title: Get started with PickVerNode
walkthrough.description: Switch your Node version from the status bar, without opening a terminal.
walkthrough.manager.title: 1. Have a version manager
walkthrough.manager.description:
PickVerNode does not install Node: it is the remote control for nvm, nvm-windows, fnm, Volta or asdf.
If you see `Node $(warning)` in the status bar, none was detected.
[Choose manager](command:pickvernode.selectProvider)
walkthrough.manager.alt: PickVerNode detects the installed version manager
walkthrough.switch.title: 2. Switch version
walkthrough.switch.description:
Click `$(versions) Node ...` at the bottom right: the list opens with the installed versions, plus install and uninstall.
[Open the list](command:pickvernode.pick)
walkthrough.switch.alt: One click on the status bar opens the version list
walkthrough.nvmrc.title: 3. Pin the project version
walkthrough.nvmrc.description:
Save the active version to a `.nvmrc` so the rest of the team uses the same one.
[Write .nvmrc](command:pickvernode.writeNvmrc)
walkthrough.nvmrc.alt: Saving the current version to a .nvmrc file
walkthrough.mismatch.title: 4. Get warned when it does not match
walkthrough.mismatch.description:
If the project pins a version (`.nvmrc`, `.node-version`, `.tool-versions`, `volta.node` or `engines.node`) and the active one does not satisfy it, the status bar turns orange and a notification shows up. It never switches the version on its own.
[Use the project one](command:pickvernode.useRequired)
walkthrough.mismatch.alt: The status bar warns when the active version does not satisfy the project
walkthrough.uac.title: 5. Windows: the UAC prompt
walkthrough.uac.description:
`nvm-windows` needs administrator rights to move the symlink, so every switch opens a UAC dialog. You can turn it off with `pickvernode.elevate` (then you run `nvm use` by hand).
[Show the setting](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22pickvernode.elevate%22)
walkthrough.uac.alt: UAC prompt on Windows with nvm-windows
